# Learned instinct: supply-chain-sbom-required (confidence 0.9)

Every build artifact must be accompanied by an SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) in SPDX or CycloneDX format. Generate with `syft`. The SBOM is stored as a GitLab CI artifact and reviewed on every merge for unexpected new dependencies. This satisfies PCI DSS Req 6.3.2 (maintain inventory of all software components).

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 6.3.2; SLSA provenance requirements
